venue.name: MONK Art Gallery & Studio
venue.description: MONK Art Gallery & Studio is the Parksville gallery of the west coast artist who signs her work MONK. The site places it at 151A Morison Avenue, across from the beach club in central Parksville, and says the gallery can also be opened by appointment outside its regular hours through the form on the website. MONK works with families, community groups and corporate groups to paint on canvases, and signs a dedication on the back of the finished painting. The same business keeps a second address at Rathtrevor Beach, listed separately as Monk's Rathtrevor Beach Studio, so it is worth confirming which one you are being sent to.

programs.name: Paint with MONK
programs.description: MONK paints with families, community groups and corporate groups, and the finished painting carries a signed dedication on the back. The site publishes no price, no length, no age range and no group size for this, and it does not say which of MONK's two Parksville addresses a session runs at. It is arranged by contacting MONK through the form on the website or by phone.
programs.what_children_do: Children put a brush on a canvas alongside MONK and add to a painting rather than watching one being made. The finished work is signed with a dedication on the back.
programs.our_note: The site does not say which of MONK's two Parksville addresses a session happens at. One is a gallery in town, the other is on the grass beside Rathtrevor Beach, so settle that before anything else. Nothing about price, length or group size is published either, so treat the first call as the whole booking conversation.
programs.practical_summary: Nothing is published about washrooms, an indoor lunch space, parking or what happens in the rain, so all of that has to be asked. Their own pages also give two different sets of opening times for the gallery.
programs.evidence: MONK works with families, community groups and corporate groups to create original memories on art work with signed dedications

images.alt: A painting of an old growth forest, with a leaf covered path winding between mossy trunks and ferns.

gaps: No price, no length, no age range and no group size are published for painting with MONK. All of it has to come from a phone call or the form on the site.
The site never mentions schools or daycares. It says MONK works with families, community groups and corporate groups, so whether a class or a daycare group is welcome is simply unknown.
Nothing is published about washrooms, an indoor lunch space, a wet weather plan, step free access or where a bus would park.
No email address is published anywhere on the site. Contact is by phone or by the form on the contact page.

Monk's Rathtrevor Beach Studio is the same business at a second Parksville address, about three and a half kilometres away, and is recorded separately under that name. The painting offering is recorded here only, so a director is not shown it twice, but the site does not say which of the two addresses a session runs at.

The site publishes MONK's paintings rather than photographs of the gallery, so the picture on this record is one of her paintings and not the room a group would walk into. No interior or exterior photograph of the gallery is published.
The home page carries no Open Graph image, so the picture used is the banner painting at the top of the home page.

The two Get Directions buttons on the home and contact pages both link back to the site rather than to a map, and no coordinates are published, so the point on the map here was worked out from the street address at the foot of their pages.

values: Monday closed, Tuesday to Sunday 11 AM to 3 PM
conflicts.note: Their own pages give two different opening times for the gallery. One says closed Monday and open 11 to 3 the rest of the week. The other says Monday to Friday, 10 to 4. Worth settling when you book, and they will open by appointment anyway.
The street name is spelled two ways on their site, Morison and Morrison. If your map app cannot find one, try the other. We use the spelling from the address at the foot of their pages.
